```{r}
source(here::here("R", "paths.R"))
source(here::here("R", "exclusions.R"))
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(vroom)
```

```{r Get CDR3 AA Data}
# Quality-filtered TRUST4 IGH sequences (built by dataset/08_preliminary_trust4.R)
filtering <- 
  read_csv(data_path("sequences/preliminary-trust4-quality-sequences.csv")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(BioProject) & (!is.na(DonorID) | !is.na(Age) | !is.na(Sex))) %>%
  drop_duplicate_repertoires("BioProject", "DonorID")   # duplicated repertoires (R/exclusions.R)
```

```{r Deduplicated datasets}
# Individual-deduplicated (for within-project analysis)
# Restrict to donors with a known DonorID so unidentified patients don't inflate counts
indiv_dedup <- filtering %>%
  filter(!is.na(BioProject), !is.na(DonorID), str_length(junction_aa) > 1) %>%
  mutate(Disease = fct_lump(Disease, n = 1)) %>%
  group_by(BioProject, DonorID, Age, Sex, Disease) %>%
  distinct(junction_aa) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(junction_len = nchar(junction_aa))

# Project-deduplicated (for across-project analysis)
# Same DonorID requirement — unidentified donors could represent multiple individuals
project_dedup <- filtering %>%
  filter(!is.na(BioProject), !is.na(DonorID), str_length(junction_aa) > 1) %>%
  mutate(Disease = fct_lump(Disease, n = 1)) %>%
  group_by(BioProject, Disease) %>%
  distinct(junction_aa) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(junction_len = nchar(junction_aa))
```

```{r Empirical collision rate across scales}
# Measure the actual collision rate (distinct junction_aa appearing ≥2 times)
# at many sample sizes by repeated subsampling. The junction_aa frequency
# distribution is too skewed for any analytic formula (birthday-problem,
# Poisson occupancy, etc.) so we estimate empirically instead.

set.seed(42)
sample_sizes <- c(1e2, 2e2, 5e2, 1e3, 2e3, 5e3, 1e4, 2e4, 5e4, 1e5, 2e5, 3e5, 4e5)
n_reps <- 20

count_collisions <- function(data, size) {
  sampled <- data %>% slice_sample(n = min(size, nrow(data)))
  sampled %>%
    group_by(junction_aa) %>%
    filter(n() > 1) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    summarize(n = n_distinct(junction_aa)) %>%
    pull(n)
}

# Within-project pool (indiv_dedup)
within_rates <- expand_grid(sample_size = sample_sizes, rep = 1:n_reps) %>%
  filter(sample_size <= nrow(indiv_dedup)) %>%
  mutate(n_collisions = map_dbl(sample_size, ~count_collisions(indiv_dedup, .x)))

# Across-project pool (project_dedup)
across_rates <- expand_grid(sample_size = sample_sizes, rep = 1:n_reps) %>%
  filter(sample_size <= nrow(project_dedup)) %>%
  mutate(n_collisions = map_dbl(sample_size, ~count_collisions(project_dedup, .x)))

# Fit log-log linear models (collisions scale as power law with sample size)
fit_within <- lm(log(n_collisions) ~ log(sample_size),
                 data = within_rates %>% filter(n_collisions > 0))
fit_across <- lm(log(n_collisions) ~ log(sample_size),
                 data = across_rates %>% filter(n_collisions > 0))

expected_collisions_within <- function(N) {
  exp(predict(fit_within, newdata = tibble(sample_size = N))) %>% unname()
}
expected_collisions_across <- function(N) {
  exp(predict(fit_across, newdata = tibble(sample_size = N))) %>% unname()
}

# Validate: observed vs predicted fold should be ~1 across scales
within_rates %>%
  filter(n_collisions > 0) %>%
  group_by(sample_size) %>%
  summarize(observed = mean(n_collisions)) %>%
  mutate(expected = expected_collisions_within(sample_size),
         fold = observed / expected)

summary(fit_within)
summary(fit_across)
```

```{r Clone rate enrichment by study}
# The study is the unit of replication: sequences within a study are clonally related and share
# patients, so tests over sequence counts would treat them as independent. Estimates use all data;
# their uncertainty comes from a leave-one-study-out jackknife (a bootstrap cannot be used for the
# across-study arm, where a study drawn twice would share every clone with itself). The expected
# collision curves fitted above are held fixed.

# Within study: CDR3s shared between patients of the same study, per study and disease group
within_by_study <- indiv_dedup %>%
  count(BioProject, Disease, junction_aa, name = "n_patients") %>%
  group_by(BioProject, Disease) %>%
  summarize(clones = sum(n_patients > 1), total = sum(n_patients), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(expected = expected_collisions_within(total))

within_enrichment <- function(drop = NULL) {
  within_by_study %>%
    filter(!BioProject %in% drop) %>%
    group_by(Disease) %>%
    summarize(enrichment = mean(clones / total) / mean(expected / total), .groups = "drop")
}

# Across studies: CDR3s shared between studies, each study deduplicated, per disease group
across_enrichment <- function(drop = NULL) {
  project_dedup %>%
    filter(!BioProject %in% drop) %>%
    count(Disease, junction_aa, name = "n_studies") %>%
    group_by(Disease) %>%
    summarize(clones = sum(n_studies > 1), total = sum(n_studies), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(enrichment = (clones / total) / (expected_collisions_across(total) / total)) %>%
    select(Disease, enrichment)
}

estimate_log10 <- function(drop = NULL) {
  bind_rows(`Within study` = within_enrichment(drop), `Across studies` = across_enrichment(drop),
            .id = "group") %>%
    mutate(log_enrichment = log10(enrichment)) %>%
    select(group, Disease, log_enrichment)
}

full <- estimate_log10()
studies_by_disease <- distinct(project_dedup, Disease, BioProject)
jackknife <- map_dfr(unique(studies_by_disease$BioProject),
                     ~ estimate_log10(drop = .x) %>% mutate(left_out = .x))

# Jackknife over the studies that contain each disease group (leaving out any other study changes nothing)
jk <- jackknife %>%
  semi_join(studies_by_disease, by = c("Disease", "left_out" = "BioProject"))
jk_se <- function(x) { n <- length(x); sqrt((n - 1) / n * sum((x - mean(x))^2)) }

clone_enrichment <- jk %>%
  group_by(group, Disease) %>%
  summarize(n_studies = n(), se = jk_se(log_enrichment), .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(full, by = c("group", "Disease")) %>%
  mutate(ci_low  = log_enrichment - qt(0.975, n_studies - 1) * se,
         ci_high = log_enrichment + qt(0.975, n_studies - 1) * se,
         p_vs_expected = 2 * pt(-abs(log_enrichment / se), n_studies - 1))

# Within vs across, paired over the same left-out study
within_vs_across <- jk %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = group, values_from = log_enrichment) %>%
  mutate(diff = `Within study` - `Across studies`) %>%
  group_by(Disease) %>%
  summarize(n_studies = n(), se_diff = jk_se(diff), .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(full %>% pivot_wider(names_from = group, values_from = log_enrichment) %>%
              transmute(Disease, diff = `Within study` - `Across studies`), by = "Disease") %>%
  mutate(p_within_vs_across = 2 * pt(-abs(diff / se_diff), n_studies - 1))

clone_enrichment
within_vs_across
write_csv(left_join(clone_enrichment, select(within_vs_across, Disease, p_within_vs_across), by = "Disease"),
          out_path('figures/fig1H_clone_rate_enrichment.csv'))
```

```{r Plot clone rate enrichment}
clone_enrichment %>%
  mutate(group = fct_relevel(group, "Within study")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = group, y = log_enrichment, fill = Disease)) +
  geom_col(position = 'dodge') +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = ci_low, ymax = ci_high),
                position = position_dodge(width = 0.9), width = 0.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +
  theme_linedraw(base_size = 10) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d() +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank()) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "log10(clone rate enrichment)",
       caption = "Bars: all studies; error bars: 95% CI, leave-one-study-out jackknife")

ggsave(out_path('figures/fig1H_clone_rate_enrichment.svg'))
```
